other_conditions: Student and his/her parents must belong to the Brahmin community
Parents should be residing in Andhra Pradesh
Student must be enrolled in a recognized and reputed college for the academic year
Student must have cleared all subjects of the previous year
Student must be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS)
Student must not have availed any amount under any other government scheme for the same purpose
Students receiving benefits from Archaka Welfare Trust are also eligible under this scheme
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per post‑graduation student.
